acid_flask.name: Acid Flask
acid_flask.description: Throw a flask that deals 4 damage and shreds 4 armour from everything in 3 blocks for 8 s.

arrow_deflection.name: Arrow Deflection
arrow_deflection.description: For 5 s, projectiles that hit you bounce back at their shooter.

arrow_rain.name: Arrow Rain
arrow_rain.description: A volley of 10 arrows falls on the spot you look at (within 24 blocks), spread over 4 blocks.

boarding_hook.name: Boarding Hook
boarding_hook.description: Fire a grappling hook that pulls the target to you.

bola.name: Bola
bola.description: Throw a bola that wraps the target: it is rooted for 3 s and can't attack for 1.5 s.

bountiful_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful_harvest.description: Every crop within 6 blocks grows one stage instantly.

branding_iron.name: Branding Iron
branding_iron.description: Brand a creature: it glows for 60 s and drops double loot if you kill it.

bribe.name: Bribe
bribe.description: Spend 3 emeralds: the hostile mob you look at stops attacking you for 15 s.

burning_faith.name: Burning Faith
burning_faith.description: Your melee hits set targets on fire for 6 s; you get Fire Resistance while it lasts (12 s).

caravan_guard.name: Caravan Guard
caravan_guard.description: Summon an iron-golem guard for 30 s (once every 5 minutes).

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.description: Taunt every enemy within 10 blocks to attack you for 6 s; you take 15% less damage while they do.

chum_the_water.name: Chum the Water
chum_the_water.description: For 60 s, fish bite twice as fast within 8 blocks of the spot you look at.

coin_toss.name: Coin Toss
coin_toss.description: Throw a gold coin: on heads you get Luck II and Speed I for 20 s; on tails the target takes 6 damage.

compost.name: Compost
compost.description: Turn rotten flesh, seeds and saplings in your inventory into bone meal.

consecrate.name: Consecrate
consecrate.description: Bless the ground in 4 blocks for 8 s: undead in it take 3 damage a second and burn.

crossbow_pavise.name: Pavise
crossbow_pavise.description: Plant a wooden shield for 15 s that blocks projectiles coming from the front.

deep_breath.name: Deep Breath
deep_breath.description: Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 60 s.

divine_shield.name: Divine Shield
divine_shield.description: Become immune to damage for 2 s but deal 50% less damage for 6 s.

elixir_of_vigor.name: Elixir of Vigor
elixir_of_vigor.description: Drink: Strength I, Speed I and Haste I for 30 s.

encore.name: Encore
encore.description: Refresh the duration of every positive effect on allies within 10 blocks.

fatten_up.name: Fatten Up
fatten_up.description: Baby animals within 8 blocks grow up instantly.

feast.name: Feast
feast.description: Lay out a feast for 20 s: players who stand by it regenerate health and hunger and get Strength I for 2 minutes.

feral_bond.name: Feral Bond
feral_bond.description: For 12 s you share damage with your nearest tamed animal: each of you takes half of what either takes.

fisher_net_throw.name: Net Throw
fisher_net_throw.description: Throw a net that roots every creature in a 3-block area for 3 s.

flagellate.name: Flagellate
flagellate.description: Lose 4 health to gain Strength II and Speed I for 10 s.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.description: A quick 3-hit combo on the enemy in front, each hit 60% of your attack damage.

forest_friend.name: Forest Friend
forest_friend.description: In a forest biome: Regeneration I and +10% speed for 30 s.

forge_heat.name: Forge Heat
forge_heat.description: Smelt every raw ore in your inventory instantly (once every 5 minutes).

grappling_rope.name: Grappling Rope
grappling_rope.description: Fire a rope that pulls the creature you hit toward you (no pulling yourself).

hammer_strike.name: Hammer Strike
hammer_strike.description: A heavy blow for +50% damage that shreds 3 armour from the target for 8 s.

hard_hat.name: Hard Hat
hard_hat.description: For 30 s: Resistance I and immunity to damage from falling blocks and suffocation.

harrier.name: Harrier
harrier.description: For 10 s, each hit you land on a different enemy gives +5% speed (stacks 5 times).

healing_garden.name: Healing Garden
healing_garden.description: Flowers bloom in a 4-block circle for 12 s; allies in it get Regeneration I.

herd_call.name: Herd Call
herd_call.description: Every farm animal within 24 blocks walks to you.

hired_muscle.name: Hired Muscle
hired_muscle.description: Summon a vindicator mercenary that fights for you for 30 s.

holy_smite.name: Holy Smite
holy_smite.description: A light strikes the target for 6 damage (12 to undead) and blinds it for 2 s.

honey_trap.name: Honey Trap
honey_trap.description: Throw honey on the ground for 8 s: enemies in a 3-block patch are slowed heavily and can't jump.

hook_and_reel.name: Hook and Reel
hook_and_reel.description: Cast a hook that pulls the creature you hit 6 blocks toward you.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: Mark an ally for 10 s: 40% of the damage it takes is redirected to you.

iron_stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron_stomach.description: Cure poison, hunger and nausea and become immune to them for 60 s.

log_throw.name: Log Throw
log_throw.description: Hurl a log that rolls 10 blocks forward, hitting enemies for 6 damage and knocking them back.

lookout.name: Lookout
lookout.description: For 20 s, every enemy within 40 blocks glows and you get Night Vision.

lullaby.name: Lullaby
lullaby.description: Enemies within 8 blocks fall asleep (can't move or attack) for 4 s or until hit.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.description: Thrust forward 4 blocks along the ground, hitting the first enemy for +50% damage.

mana_burst.name: Mana Burst
mana_burst.description: Spend 30 mana: an arcane blast around you deals 6 damage and knocks enemies back 4 blocks.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.description: For 10 s, damage you take heals every ally within 8 blocks for half of it.

mend_beast.name: Mend Beast
mend_beast.description: Heal every tamed animal within 12 blocks for 10 and give them Regeneration I for 10 s.

miner_s_lamp.name: Miner's Lamp
miner_s_lamp.description: Night Vision for 3 minutes and a 5-block light that follows you.

monster_lore.name: Monster Lore
monster_lore.description: Look at a creature: it glows for 15 s and takes 15% more damage from you and your allies.

mounted_charge.name: Mounted Charge
mounted_charge.description: While riding: your mount surges forward for 3 s at double speed; enemies you run into take 6 damage and are knocked back.

mourner_s_veil.name: Mourner's Veil
mourner_s_veil.description: For 15 s, undead ignore you unless you attack them.

overchannel.name: Overchannel
overchannel.description: For 8 s, spells cost 30% more mana but deal 25% more damage.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: For 30 s: +20% speed and step up full blocks without jumping.

pickaxe_strike.name: Pickaxe Strike
pickaxe_strike.description: A heavy blow with a pickaxe for +60% damage that shreds 4 armour for 8 s.

pike_wall.name: Pike Wall
pike_wall.description: A row of spikes rises from the ground in front of you for 8 s; enemies touching them take 3 damage a second.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.description: Your next arrow roots the target in place for 3 s.

poultice.name: Poultice
poultice.description: Heal yourself or the ally you look at for 8 and stop bleeding and poison.

purify.name: Purify
purify.description: Clear every negative effect from you and allies within 6 blocks.

quiver_refill.name: Quiver Refill
quiver_refill.description: Conjure 16 arrows into your inventory (once every 2 minutes).

rest_in_peace.name: Rest in Peace
rest_in_peace.description: Undead within 6 blocks are stunned for 3 s and take 6 damage.

riposte_stance.name: Riposte Stance
riposte_stance.description: For 6 s, every melee hit you take is answered with an automatic counter for 75% of your attack damage.

riptide_slash.name: Riptide Slash
riptide_slash.description: Swing a wave forward: enemies in a 5-block cone take 5 damage and are pushed back; stronger in water.

rogue_caltrops.name: Caltrops
rogue_caltrops.description: Scatter caltrops in a 3-block area for 10 s: enemies walking over them take 2 damage and get Slowness II.

rogue_smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
rogue_smoke_bomb.description: Throw a smoke cloud (4 blocks, 6 s): enemies inside get Blindness and lose track of you; you get Invisibility while inside.

runic_strike.name: Runic Strike
runic_strike.description: Your next melee hit releases a magic missile at the nearest other enemy.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: A 5-block circle for 10 s: allies in it heal 1 health a second; enemies can't hit from inside it.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.description: Place a scarecrow for 60 s: hostile mobs within 8 blocks get Slowness I and target it first.

sea_shanty.name: Sea Shanty
sea_shanty.description: For 15 s, you and allies within 10 blocks get +10% attack speed and Water Breathing.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Restore all your stamina and hunger once every 5 minutes.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: For 6 s, allies standing behind you take 30% less damage from the front.

shovel_slam.name: Shovel Slam
shovel_slam.description: A wide shovel swing: enemies in a 3-block arc take +40% damage and are knocked down for 1 s.

silver_oil.name: Silver Oil
silver_oil.description: For 20 s your weapon deals +4 damage to undead and sets them on fire.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.description: A long thrust that hits every enemy in a 5-block line in front of you.

song_of_courage.name: Song of Courage
song_of_courage.description: For 20 s, allies within 10 blocks get +10% attack damage and +10% attack speed.

spice_mix.name: Spice Mix
spice_mix.description: For 5 minutes, every food you eat also gives Speed I and Regeneration I for 10 s.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.description: 3 summoned boars charge forward 12 blocks, knocking enemies aside and dealing 5 damage each.

steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
steady_aim.description: Crouch still for 2 s: your next bolt crits for +75% damage.

stinger_shot.name: Stinger Shot
stinger_shot.description: Fire 3 stingers that deal 3 damage and Poison I for 4 s each.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Release 4 bees that attack the enemy you look at for 15 s (they don't die after stinging).

sweep_the_legs.name: Sweep the Legs
sweep_the_legs.description: Spin your spear: every enemy within 4 blocks is knocked down (stunned) for 1.5 s.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.description: For 30 s the boat or ship you ride goes 40% faster.

taunting_shout.name: Taunting Shout
taunting_shout.description: Every enemy within 10 blocks is forced to attack you for 5 s.

temper_armour.name: Temper Armour
temper_armour.description: You and an ally you look at gain +3 armour and +1 toughness for 30 s.

thornbush.name: Thornbush
thornbush.description: A ring of thorny bushes grows around you for 10 s; enemies that touch it take 2 damage and are slowed.

throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing_knives.description: Throw 3 knives in a fan, 4 damage each.

tracker_s_instinct.name: Tracker's Instinct
tracker_s_instinct.description: Every illager, witch and pillager within 48 blocks glows for 20 s.

trample.name: Trample
trample.description: While riding: enemies within 2 blocks of your mount take 3 damage a second for 6 s.

tripwire.name: Tripwire
tripwire.description: Place an invisible tripwire trap: the first enemy to cross it is knocked down (stunned) for 2 s and slowed for 4 s.

trophy_strength.name: Trophy Strength
trophy_strength.description: Each undead or arthropod you killed in the last 60 s gives +2% damage (up to 20%) for 30 s.

turn_undead.name: Turn Undead
turn_undead.description: Undead within 10 blocks flee from you for 6 s and get Weakness II.

unhorse.name: Unhorse
unhorse.description: Knock the target off whatever it rides and stun it for 2 s.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Become invisible for 6 s and drop the aggro of every enemy within 16 blocks.

volatile_mix.name: Volatile Mix
volatile_mix.description: Throw a flask that bursts into a random harmful cloud (poison, slowness, weakness or blindness) for 6 s.

volley_fire.name: Volley Fire
volley_fire.description: Fire 3 bolts at once in a narrow spread from your loaded crossbow.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Shout: you and allies within 8 blocks get Strength I for 8 s; enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 5 s.

warrior_shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
warrior_shield_bash.description: Strike with your shield: the enemy in front takes 4 damage, is knocked back 3 blocks and is stunned for 1 s. Needs a shield.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Plant yourself for 8 s: you can't move but gain Resistance II and +30% ranged damage.

weather_eye.name: Weather Eye
weather_eye.description: See the weather for the next 10 minutes and get Conduit Power for 30 s.

woodsman_s_grit.name: Woodsman's Grit
woodsman_s_grit.description: For 15 s: Resistance I and Haste II.
